name_normalization: NFKD -> ASCII ignoring diacritics -> lowercase -> retain a-z and 0-9; explicit audited aliases only; no fuzzy matching
by_team_semantics: season|team_abbreviation -> full-season roster record IDs, all 30 teams each season; includes players who left during the season, excludes transaction-only associations
by_jersey_semantics: season|team_abbreviation|single jersey text -> all known roster player IDs; 0 differs from 00; raw multi-number text preserved
not_in_rating_scope_semantics: No player-season row in available full-season rosters. Does not mean a zero rating or prove no NBA contract. Existing missing_record rows are roster members with no sourced rating.

field_provenance.rule: For a non-null metric: use records[record_id].field_source_ids[field] if present, otherwise default_source_id only when field is listed in baseline_fields. Null metrics have no value source.
